# Version 4.159.0 (Unreleased)
> **Linux architecture support changes**

## Highlights

The upcoming release drops Linux x86 native assets.

## Breaking Changes

- **Move Linux x86 deployments to a supported architecture** — Linux x86 native assets will no longer be built or included in NuGet packages. Move 32-bit x86 Linux deployments to a supported architecture before upgrading to this release. ([#5784](https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5784))
